name: Custom Click Buffer
description: Saves you from bad clicks: cancels or delays a click that would kill you, and buffers early jumps and orb clicks.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the whole mod on or off.

fix-early-clicks.name: Fix Bad Clicks
fix-early-clicks.description: When you click, the mod quickly tests the next moment of gameplay. If the click would kill you, it delays or cancels it (see "If a click would kill you"). Player 1 only. Can cause small stutters on heavy levels.

bad-click-mode.name: If a click would kill you
bad-click-mode.description: Delay, then cancel: try clicking up to Max Click Delay later; if no delay saves you, cancel the click. Cancel only: never delay, just throw the click away. Delay only: never cancel.

pred-delay.name: Max Click Delay (frames)
pred-delay.description: The furthest the mod may push a click later to save you (1-5 frames).

pred-look-ms.name: Look-ahead (ms)
pred-look-ms.description: How far into the future each test checks for a death. ~300 ms covers a full cube jump. Higher = catches more, but more stutter.

pred-hold-ms.name: Assumed Hold (ms)
pred-hold-ms.description: How long the test assumes you hold the click. Set it near your normal tap length.

frames.name: Buffer Window (frames)
frames.description: If you click up to this many frames too early (in the air before landing, or before reaching an orb), the mod clicks for you the moment the click would work (1-5). It never holds your button longer than you did.

player2.name: Buffer Player 2
player2.description: Also buffer clicks for player 2 (dual mode).

show-hud.name: Show On-Screen Feedback
show-hud.description: Shows a small readout in the bottom-left of the level: what the mod just did, plus running counts.
